site_name: Land to the rear of 58-64 Southgate Road
description: Placing of storage containers and staff welfare facilities on the site for a temporary period of ten years, with associated works and installation of replacement entrance gates.
decision_conditions: <p><span id="docs-internal-guid-aff804c6-7fff-416b-acf7-5202cd9f9677"><span style="font-size: 10pt; font-family: Arial, sans-serif; background-color: transparent; font-variant-numeric: normal; font-variant-east-asian: normal; font-variant-alternates: normal; font-variant-position: normal; font-variant-emoji: normal; vertical-align: baseline; white-space-collapse: preserve;">In the absence of sufficient information regarding the proposed operations at the site, including the failure to submit an acoustic assessment and Operation Management Plan, it has not been demonstrated that the proposed development would have an acceptable impact in terms of noise and disturbance on the amenities of neighbouring occupiers and the wider conservation area. The proposal would therefore conflict with policy LP2 (Development and Amenity) of the Hackney Local Plan LP33 (2020) and policy D3 (Optimising site layout through the design-led approach) of the London Plan (2021).</span></span></p>

<p><span id="docs-internal-guid-012a086e-7fff-b502-5ee1-46c7d449bf6b"><span style="font-size: 10pt; font-family: Arial, sans-serif; font-variant-numeric: normal; font-variant-east-asian: normal; font-variant-alternates: normal; font-variant-position: normal; font-variant-emoji: normal; vertical-align: baseline; white-space-collapse: preserve;">Failure to provide biodiversity enhancement contrary to policies LP46 (Protection and Enhancement of Green Infrastructure), and LP47 (Biodiversity and Sites of Importance of Nature Conservation) of the Hackney Local Plan (2020), and policies G1 (Green infrastructure), and G6 (Biodiversity and access to nature) of the London Plan (2021). Failure to provide a BNG Statement as required by </span><a href="https://www.legislation.gov.uk/ukpga/2021/30/schedule/14/enacted"><span style="font-size: 10pt; font-family: Arial, sans-serif; color: rgb(0, 0, 0); font-variant-numeric: normal; font-variant-east-asian: normal; font-variant-alternates: normal; font-variant-position: normal; font-variant-emoji: normal; vertical-align: baseline; white-space-collapse: preserve;">Schedule 7A of the Town and Country Planning Act 1990 (as inserted by Schedule 14 of the Environment Act 2021</span></a><span style="font-size: 10pt; font-family: Arial, sans-serif; font-variant-numeric: normal; font-variant-east-asian: normal; font-variant-alternates: normal; font-variant-position: normal; font-variant-emoji: normal; vertical-align: baseline; white-space-collapse: preserve;">).</span></span></p>

<p><span id="docs-internal-guid-161d7d82-7fff-f12b-a7de-1166bfdca0c3"><span style="font-size: 10pt; font-family: Arial, sans-serif; font-variant-numeric: normal; font-variant-east-asian: normal; font-variant-alternates: normal; font-variant-position: normal; font-variant-emoji: normal; vertical-align: baseline; white-space-collapse: preserve;">By reason of its inappropriate size, scale, and materials, the proposed temporary shipping containers would result in an obtrusive and incongruous development that would fail to preserve or enhance the character and appearance of the De Beauvoir Conservation Area. This identified less than substantial harm would not be outweighed by any public benefits. The proposed development would, therefore, conflict with policies D3 (Optimising site layout through the design-led approach), D4 (Delivering good design), and HC1 (Heritage conservation and growth) of the London Plan (2021) and policies LP1 (Design Quality and Local Character) and LP3 (Designated Heritage Assets) of the Hackney Local Plan 2033 (2020).</span></span></p>
